builder.objective: V2-06 phase 1 — Establish the Research Analytics Plane contracts, PrivacyTransformPipeline, PrivacyReleaseGate, and ResearchAnalyticsGateway. Prove analytics can be disabled without breaking any product function. Begin Operational Store / Research Analytics Store separation architecture.
builder.scope:
V2-06 has two major halves per ROADMAP.md: (1) Backend operational (auth/sync/billing/permissions/invitations) and (2) Research Analytics Plane (privacy-first data pipeline). This cycle covers the foundational analytics privacy architecture:

Required:
1. `ResearchAnalyticsGateway` port — contract for emitting minimized statistical facts from the operational domain to the analytics plane. Must be disableable with zero product-side breakage.
2. `TaskTaxonomyService` — versioned taxonomy mapping free-text task labels to statistical categories. The product keeps free text; analytics never sees raw labels.
3. `PrivacyTransformPipeline` — transforms operational facts into analytics-safe records: strips all account/household/member IDs, replaces free text with taxonomy references, generalizes timestamps and demographics, suppresses rare cells/cohortes.
4. `PrivacyReleaseGate` — gates every external analytics output. Must check: no operational IDs, no free text, minimum cohort sizes, rare cell suppression, differencing/reconstruction risk, provenance, re-identification risk.
5. Analytics disableability proof — demonstrate that disabling the ResearchAnalyticsGateway adapter produces zero broken tests, zero runtime errors, and identical product behavior.
6. Research Analytics Store schema (TypeScript types) — must contain NO operational IDs, NO free text, NO join keys. Only statistical aggregates, taxonomy IDs, and generalized variables.
7. Tests proving the analytics boundary: no operational IDs leak into analytics types, no free text enters the pipeline, PrivacyReleaseGate rejects non-compliant outputs.

Do NOT yet implement: backend operational adapters (auth/sync/billing), network sync, push notifications, calendar integration, or differential privacy API. Those are V2-06 phase 2.

Preserve all V2-00..V2-05 invariants. No regression. Navigation stays 3 tabs. Premium contextuel non agressif.
acceptance: ResearchAnalyticsGateway port defined with disableability contract
PrivacyTransformPipeline strips all operational IDs and free text
PrivacyReleaseGate checks cohort size, rare cells, IDs, free text, provenance
Research Analytics Store types contain zero operational IDs, zero free text, zero join keys
Analytics disableability: disabling gateway produces zero test failures and identical product behavior
Dedicated tests for analytics boundary (negative tests for ID/text leakage)
